{{Quote|The name is silly; the threat is not. These are aggressive, dangerous fighters.|[[Beissa]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
The '''Rancor Clan''' was a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:B" /> Contrary to the majority of the Dathomiri witches,<ref name="PLCop">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> the Rancor Clan members manged to avoid being trapped on the surface of Dathomir when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established the [[blockade of Dathomir]]. They then acquired [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and maintained a presence in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]. Rancor Clan pilots flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]], [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rancor Clan interfered with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to expand his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]] in the Dathomir system. This prompted [[Beissa]], the lieutenant of Jabba leading all the Hutt's space operations, to battle the Rancor Clan.<ref name="SWG:DtRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateRancorClanPilots.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Rancor Clan pilots]]
The Rancor Clan appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtRC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rancor Clan was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DtRC" />
